title: Closures: counter factory
prompt: Implement `static (Func<int> Next, Action Reset) MakeCounter(int start)` — `Next()` returns the current value then increments; `Reset()` restores the value to `start`. Each call to `MakeCounter` must produce an INDEPENDENT counter.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Next reads-then-increments; Reset restores the captured start.

tests.name: independence
tests.hint: Two counters, two captured states — closure per call, not per method.
